name: Sword of Life Stealing
summary: A sword that drains extra Necrotic damage and gives you Temporary Hit Points on a 20.

stats.effect: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 15 Necrotic damage if it isn't a Construct or an Undead, and you gain {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points} equal to the amount of Necrotic damage taken.
